chunks.subject: AP Macroeconomics
chunks.title: Q2 Short FRQ (5 points) — Set 2: contractionary monetary policy & bond prices
chunks.content: AP Macroeconomics FRQ 2 (Short), 5 points, one per element. Set 2 answer key highlights: state the central bank would increase its administered interest rates (or sell bonds); draw a correctly labeled reserve market with the appropriate supply-curve shift; state that the price of previously issued bonds will decrease; plus related state/explain elements linking the policy to interest rates and the economy. Same 5-point structure as Set 1. Common failure: unlabeled graph; stating the bond-price direction without the interest-rate relationship; wrong policy direction.

chunks.content: Q2 (Set 2) scored 1/5 — earned only one element (a single state or graph point), losing the graph shift, the bond-price relationship, and the explanations. Illustrates a low short-FRQ response that cannot connect the monetary tool to its effects.
